state.paragraph: - `# async-routing` (api: `IncidentServiceVal.retry` ×3 — `ConditionalsBoundaryMutator` plus both `RemoveConditionalMutator_ORDER_*`) — the `retryDelay > 0` guard routes between `exceptionallyComposeAsync(delayedExecutor(...))` and `exceptionallyCompose`: at delay 0 both produce identical results and differ only in which thread runs the continuation; a positive delay is distinguishable only by wall-clock timing, which the determinism rules prohibit asserting. Escape hatch: a clock seam injected into the service (replacing `delayedExecutor`) would make the routing assertable.
